source.l: The Hundred Official Site / Radio Times

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean UK Chart Record
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's collaboration 'Rein Me In' has made history, spending a record 21st non-consecutive week at No. 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart.

angles.name: Chart History Made
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is No.1 for a record 21st week, now the longest-running UK chart-topper ever!

angles.name: North East Pride
angles.copy: Our very own Sam Fender, with Olivia Dean, has just smashed a UK chart record! 'Rein Me In' is No.1 for a staggering 21 weeks.

angles.copy: Still buzzing from Madonna and Kylie's new track 'Love Sensation' making the Top 10. Pure pop gold!
